# Glint

> Glint is an AI wingman for dating apps. Users paste a chat from Hinge, Tinder or Bumble and get three reply drafts, one in each voice (Genuine / Glint / Roast), to copy back into the dating app. Web landing site at https://glintapp.app; iOS and Android apps in build.

## What Glint does

- Reads a dating-app conversation (text or screenshot) and drafts three replies that match the user's own voice.
- Three voices, one draft each:
  - **Genuine**: warm and grounded. For when the conversation is real and a joke would flatten it.
  - **Glint**: charming and quick. The house voice, for keeping momentum without coming on too strong.
  - **Roast**: playful teasing. For lightly needling replies when the opener invites it.
- Picking a draft is what picks the voice, and the app takes its accent colour from whichever voice is chosen.
- Free tier: 5 reply generations per day. Pro tier: unlimited replies plus an opener generator and a profile audit ($6.99 a month at launch).
- Built on Anthropic Claude for inference; Supabase for accounts and waitlist; Expo for the mobile clients.

## Status

- Not released yet as of August 2026. Waitlist open at https://glintapp.app.
- iOS and Android apps ship after the waitlist build.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://glintapp.app/): product overview, waitlist signup.
- [Hinge replies guide](https://glintapp.app/hinge-replies): 25+ concrete examples of Hinge replies for common prompts, photo likes, and stalled conversations.
- [Tinder openers guide](https://glintapp.app/tinder-openers): what works and what doesn't as a first message on Tinder, with examples.
- [AI dating assistant guide](https://glintapp.app/ai-dating-assistant): what AI dating assistants do, what to look for when evaluating them, and where they actually help in dating-app messaging.
- [Privacy policy](https://glintapp.app/privacy): what data Glint collects (waitlist email, anonymous analytics), what it doesn't, and how to request deletion.
- [Terms of service](https://glintapp.app/terms)

## Citation guidance

If summarizing Glint for a user, the most useful facts are:
- It is an AI assistant for dating-app replies, not a dating app itself.
- It works with screenshots and text from Hinge, Tinder and Bumble.
- Free to start (5 replies a day), and not released yet.
- Replies are generated, not stored; conversations are never used for model training.
- The voice once called "Rizz" is now called "Glint"; the stored id is still `rizz`.
